evidence.scene_first: script.md:9-21 (s52001-s52004): 1769-06-03, Cook at the Tahiti shore observatory with Green and Solander, waiting to time contact.
evidence.no_spoiler: script.md:21-37 (s52004-s52008): the opening asks about agreement, the voyage, the teams, and other records; it gives none of their results.
evidence.one_line: script.md:39-63,117-147,209-263,349-483: after the June 3 cold open, the account runs from the 1768 petition through site choice, preparation, deployment, observation, and return.
evidence.no_toc: script.md:21-37 (s52004-s52008): these are unresolved story questions, with no sentence numbering chapters or announcing a presentation order; the four-question burst is dense.
evidence.chapters_link: script.md:35-43,113-121,139-147,203-213,255-263,345-353,463-471: each chapter-ending question/action is met by the next chapter's opening answer or consequence.
evidence.open_loops: script.md:65-67,85-95,139-147,177-195,239-257,289-307,323-351,375-405,419-449,463-483: new unresolved questions occur throughout the body, well within 90-second stretches.
evidence.payoffs: script.md:25,43-47,67-79 (s52005, s52009-s52010, s52015-s52018): the opening asks why people were sent to the South Pacific. The answer gives the goal of better Sun-Earth distance estimates and repeats that observers had to go there, but never gives the geographic reason that a South Pacific station was needed. The other named opening hooks get answers at s52009, s52069/s52074, s52106, and s52122.
evidence.no_recap: script.md:275,373 (s52084, s52109): seeing the full transit is asserted twice without a named callback. script.md:445-461 (s52320-s52324): the final line repeats the preceding edge/light uncertainty as a summary.
evidence.chapters_are_events: script.md:5,39,117,143,209,259,349,467: chapter headings name waiting, petitioning, choosing a site, setting up, departing, ingress, differing readings, and return.
evidence.outro_no_next: script.md:485-489: '下次看到' refers to the viewer's next encounter with a historical number; it does not tease another episode.
evidence.opening_hooks: script.md:21-37 (s52004-s52008): the opening leaves observer agreement, the Royal Society's motive, the two departing teams, and further contact records unresolved.
evidence.one_thread: script.md:17-21,43-47,147-163,183-195,327-369,425-461: the same problem of recording and comparing transit contact times drives preparation through the uncertain readings.
evidence.no_detour: script.md:131-137 (s52307-s52308) is a brief failed observation under cloud that sets up the later weather question at s52081-s52083 (script.md:255-267); no whole chapter leaves the contact-timing story.
